device_types.name: Servo-driven control surface / rudder
device_types.description: Hinged aerodynamic or hydrodynamic surface (aileron, elevator, rudder, fin) moved by a servo for attitude and heading control.

properties.name: actuator_type_id
properties.description: Usually actuator.motor.rc_servo or a smart servo

maintenance.action: check play and clevis security

device_types.name: Variable buoyancy engine
device_types.description: Pump or piston moving oil or water between internal and external volumes to change displacement; propels underwater gliders and profiling floats.

maintenance.action: inspect seals and bladder; check for leaks

device_types.name: Electronic speed controller (ESC), UAV/hobby
device_types.description: Lightweight BLDC inverter (BLHeli/AM32-class or FOC) for drone and RC motors; commanded by PWM or digital protocols such as DShot.

telemetry.name: erpm
telemetry.description: Electrical rpm; divide by pole pairs

maintenance.action: inspect after crashes

device_types.name: Low-voltage FOC servo drive
device_types.description: 12-80 V field-oriented control servo drive for BLDC/PMSM with encoder input and current, velocity and position loops; used in mobile robots, cobots and AGVs.

maintenance.action: back up parameters; verify after replacement

device_types.name: Industrial servo drive with Safe Torque Off
device_types.description: Mains-fed (230/400 V) servo amplifier with high-resolution encoder interfaces and integrated drive safety functions (STO, often SS1/SLS/SBC per IEC 61800-5-2).

properties.name: sto_safety_rating
properties.description: e.g. SIL 3 per IEC 61800-5-2 / PL e per ISO 13849-1

properties.name: ip_rating
properties.description: Ingress protection code per IEC 60529, e.g. IP54

maintenance.action: check fan and clean heatsink
reform or replace per maker after storage/end of life
proof-test STO and other safety functions per the safety manual

device_types.name: Stepper motor driver
device_types.description: Chopper current driver for 2-phase steppers with microstepping (e.g. up to 1/256) and step/direction input; IC modules to DIN-rail drives.

telemetry.name: load_indicator
telemetry.description: Back-EMF based load value where supported

device_types.name: Brushed DC H-bridge driver
device_types.description: Full-bridge (or dual) MOSFET driver for brushed DC motors with PWM speed and direction control, current sensing and protection.

device_types.name: Variable frequency drive (VFD) / inverter
device_types.description: Mains-fed inverter controlling AC induction or PM motor speed via V/f or vector control; used for conveyors, pumps, HPUs and spindles.

properties.name: ip_rating
properties.description: Ingress protection code per IEC 60529, e.g. IP54

maintenance.action: replace fan
clean dust
reform after long storage; replace at end of life

device_types.name: Hydraulic valve amplifier
device_types.description: Electronic card or valve-mounted amplifier converting a command signal into the coil current for proportional or servo valves, with dither and ramp settings.

device_types.name: Multi-axis servo drive / drive rack
device_types.description: Common DC-bus power supply with several servo axis modules (or one board driving 2-8 axes); compact robot controllers and gantries.

maintenance.action: replace fan
proof-test STO per safety manual

device_types.name: Integrated open-source-class motor controller
device_types.description: Compact FOC controller board for BLDC/PMSM (ODrive, moteus or VESC class) with encoder inputs, CAN/USB/UART and high-rate current loop; used in legged robots and research arms.
failure_modes: regen overvoltage with no brake resistor or battery

device_types.name: Piezo actuator driver / amplifier
device_types.description: Linear or switching high-voltage amplifier (e.g. -30 to 150 V) with optional sensor servo loop for piezo stacks and stages; or resonant drivers for ultrasonic motors.

device_types.name: Braking chopper / regeneration resistor
device_types.description: Switch and resistor dissipating regenerated energy when the DC bus rises during deceleration; or regenerative unit returning it to the supply.

maintenance.action: check resistance and wiring

device_types.name: Strain wave (harmonic) gear
device_types.description: Wave generator, flexspline and circular spline giving 30:1-160:1 in one stage with near-zero backlash; dominant in cobot and humanoid joints.

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: regrease or change oil per maker; check for leakage

device_types.name: Cycloidal / RV reducer
device_types.description: Eccentric-driven cycloid disc(s) against ring pins, often with a planetary pre-stage (RV); high stiffness and shock capacity for heavy robot axes.

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: regrease or change oil per maker; check for leakage

device_types.name: Planetary gearhead
device_types.description: Sun, planets and ring gear in one or more stages (typically 3:1-10:1 per stage); compact coaxial reduction on servo and DC motors.

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: regrease or change oil per maker; check for leakage

device_types.name: Worm gear reducer
device_types.description: Worm and wheel at right angles giving high single-stage ratios (5:1-100:1); low-lead versions are self-locking but inefficient.

properties.name: self_locking
properties.description: Static self-locking; do not rely on it as a safety brake

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: regrease or change oil per maker; check for leakage

device_types.name: Spur / helical gearbox
device_types.description: Parallel-shaft gear train with spur or helical gears; simple, efficient, used in gear motors and wheel drives.

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: regrease or change oil per maker; check for leakage

device_types.name: Bevel gear set
device_types.description: Straight, spiral or hypoid bevel gears transmitting motion between intersecting shafts; used in wrists, differentials and right-angle drives.

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: regrease or change oil per maker; check for leakage

device_types.name: Ball screw
device_types.description: Recirculating-ball screw and nut converting rotation to linear motion with ~90% efficiency; preloaded nuts remove backlash.

properties.name: accuracy_grade
properties.description: Lead accuracy class per ISO 3408, e.g. T5, P3

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: relubricate nut
inspect wipers

device_types.name: Lead (trapezoidal/ACME) screw
device_types.description: Sliding-contact screw and polymer or bronze nut; cheap and quiet, often self-locking at small lead angles, lower efficiency and life than ball screws.

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: measure axial play; replace nut

device_types.name: Planetary roller screw
device_types.description: Threaded rollers between screw and nut give high load capacity, stiffness and life; used in heavy electric cylinders and humanoid linear joints.

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: relubricate

device_types.name: Timing belt and pulley drive
device_types.description: Toothed belt (GT2, HTD, AT etc.) on pulleys for synchronous rotary or linear transmission; light and quiet, with belt elasticity.

telemetry.name: belt_tension
telemetry.description: Measured by sonic tension meter during service

maintenance.action: measure tension (span frequency) and readjust
replace on cracks, tooth wear or fraying

device_types.name: Rack and pinion
device_types.description: Pinion gear on a straight rack for long linear travel (gantries, 7th axes); dual-pinion or preloaded setups remove backlash.

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: lubricate rack; automatic lubricator where fitted
check backlash and alignment

device_types.name: Capstan / cable drive
device_types.description: Steel or polymer cable wound on a capstan driving a larger drum; zero backlash and highly backdrivable, used in haptics and transparent arms.

maintenance.action: inspect for fraying and re-tension

device_types.name: Roller chain drive
device_types.description: Roller chain on sprockets for robust long-centre power transmission; used in tracked robots, lifts and agricultural machines.

maintenance.action: lubricate
measure elongation; replace at maker's limit (often ~1-3%)

device_types.name: Differential (gear or mechanical)
device_types.description: Gear set dividing torque between two outputs allowing different speeds; used in vehicle axles and differential wrists of robot arms.

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: regrease or change oil per maker; check for leakage

device_types.name: Torque-limiting slip clutch
device_types.description: Friction, ball-detent or magnetic clutch that slips above a set torque to protect gearboxes and people from overload.

maintenance.action: verify slip torque

failure_modes: slip torque drift from wear or contamination

device_types.name: Spring-applied electromagnetic brake (fail-safe)
device_types.description: Springs press a friction disc when unpowered; energising the coil releases it. Used as emergency/holding brake on vertical axes and robot joints; dynamic stops wear the lining.

telemetry.name: brake_released
telemetry.description: Release feedback from microswitch or coil current

maintenance.action: measure air gap; readjust or replace rotor at max gap
perform brake holding-torque test (many controllers automate this)

device_types.name: Permanent-magnet holding brake
device_types.description: Magnet-held, zero-backlash brake built into servo motors; released by energising a coil that cancels the magnet field. Intended for holding, emergency stops only.

telemetry.name: brake_released
telemetry.description: Release feedback from microswitch or coil current

maintenance.action: verify holding torque; count emergency-stop energy

failure_modes: holding torque loss after excessive dynamic stops

device_types.name: Electromagnetic clutch
device_types.description: Coil-actuated friction or tooth clutch coupling two shafts on command; used to disengage drives for manual push or freewheel.

maintenance.action: measure and adjust

device_types.name: Shaft coupling
device_types.description: Bellows, disc, jaw (elastomer), Oldham or beam coupling joining motor, gearbox and screw shafts while accommodating misalignment.

maintenance.action: check clamp screw torque and element wear

device_types.name: Profile linear guide (rail and carriage)
device_types.description: Recirculating ball or roller carriage on a profile rail carrying load with low friction; foundation of linear axes and gantries.

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: relubricate carriages
check end seals and scrapers

device_types.name: Crossed roller bearing
device_types.description: Bearing with alternately crossed cylindrical rollers carrying radial, axial and moment loads in one compact ring; used as joint output bearings.

telemetry.name: vibration_rms
telemetry.description: Housing vibration acceleration RMS; trend against baseline

maintenance.action: regrease if not sealed for life

device_types.name: Slewing ring bearing
device_types.description: Large-diameter bearing (often with integral gear) supporting heavy rotating structures such as robot bases, cranes and turrets.

telemetry.name: tilt_clearance
telemetry.description: Periodic measurement of axial tilt; growth indicates raceway wear

maintenance.action: regrease while rotating
check mounting bolt torque
measure tilt clearance

device_types.name: Elastic element / torsion spring coupling
device_types.description: Machined torsion spring or elastomer element in series with a drive for torque sensing and impact absorption (the elastic part of an SEA).

maintenance.action: inspect for cracks; recalibrate
